headline: A 2014 law renames the VA medical center in Waco, Texas, after Navy hero Doris Miller.
what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in Waco, Texas, to the Doris Miller Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center. Doris Miller was a Navy sailor honored for his actions during the attack on Pearl Harbor. The change is a naming measure and does not describe any change to the center's services or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
